candidate.definition_en: To make a clear resonant sound; to call by telephone.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تتصل بحد بالتليفون، أو صوت الجرس لما يرن.

senses.definition_en: To make a clear resonant sound, especially of a bell or phone.
senses.definition_ar: يَرِنّ أو يُصدِر رنينًا (كالجرس أو الهاتف)

examples: Please ring the bell if you need assistance.
I will ring you as soon as I get home.
Did you hear the telephone ring?
